import random

def propose(history, bounds, seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed + len(history))
    dim = len(bounds)
    if not history:
        return [rng.uniform(low, high) for low, high in bounds]
    best = min(history, key=lambda x: x["value"])
    best_x = best["x"]
    n = len(history)
    explore_prob = max(0.05, 0.3 - 0.01 * n)
    if rng.random() < explore_prob:
        return [rng.uniform(low, high) for low, high in bounds]
    if rng.random() < 0.7:
        base = best_x
    else:
        candidates = [p["x"] for p in history]
        if len(candidates) > 1:
            base = rng.choice(candidates)
        else:
            base = best_x
    scale = max(0.01, 0.2 * (1 - n / 32))
    new_x = []
    for i, (low, high) in enumerate(bounds):
        width = high - low
        std = scale * width
        if std <= 0:
            std = 1e-6
        perturb = rng.gauss(0, std)
        val = base[i] + perturb
        val = max(low, min(high, val))
        new_x.append(val)
    return new_x
